C0072.title: Daqing Police Crack Nation's First Telecom Operator DNS Hijacking Case
C0072.summary: In November 2021, the Cyber Police Branch of the Daqing Public Security Bureau solved the nation's first DNS hijacking case involving a telecom operator. The core members of the criminal gang bribed an insider at the operator to install a hijacking program on the core switch server in the operator's server room. This program mirrored and tampered with user internet traffic, forcibly redirecting us
